text:
Clara Nguyen: Quick sync — we need a clear mapping from our internal route/quota codes to client-facing messages + console badges. current state is inconsistent and makes support calls noisy.
Bryan Lee: totally. can you sketch the buckets you want?
Clara Nguyen: thinking 3 consumer buckets: `retryable-backoff` (temporary, give `Retry-After` hint), `rate-limited` (hard quota/commit), `degraded` (fallback model / lower quality). those map to different console badges and telemetry tags.
Sara Patel: +1 to buckets. one nuance: some soft-throttles are transient but still should appear as `degraded` in the console for a short window so customers see impact.
Alex Kim: curious about exact codes. currently we emit `ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `SOFT_THROTTLE`, `FALLBACK_VARIANT`, `MODEL_DEGRADED`. do we rename or synthesize a `client_hint` field?
Clara Nguyen: proposal: keep internal codes for ops, but add `client_facing_bucket` string and `client_hint` short message (<=120 chars) in the API response. SDKs can surface `client_hint` + `x-retry-after` header when present.
Bryan Lee: SDKs can map `client_facing_bucket` -> UX: iOS/Android show a small banner for `degraded`, and show a retry snackbar for `retryable-backoff`. backend uses telemetry tag `client_bucket` for dashboards.
Sara Patel: telemetry detail: emit `client_bucket`, `route_id`, `quota_window`, and `fallback_variant` as tags. that'll let us pivot dashboards by tenant and route.
Alex Kim: for dashboards we should also surface a short human reason for top incidents. example: `Quota burst from long-running batch job` vs `SLA breach on shard`. those come from sampling the `client_hint` + ops annotations.
Clara Nguyen: agree. ops workflow: when a route gets >5% calls in `retryable-backoff` for 5m, auto-create issue and badge route as `attenuated` in Console. we need thresholds in runbook.
Sara Patel: runbook note: differentiate tenant-level quotas vs route-level rate limits. console badges: `softly degraded` (yellow), `rate limited` (red), `fallback active` (purple).
Bryan Lee: small API example for the response body we discussed: `{"error_code": "429", "internal_code": "ROUTE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "client_facing_bucket": "rate-limited", "client_hint": "Request quota exceeded for this route. Contact billing or retry after 60s."}`
Alex Kim: looks good. also add header `X-RW-Client-Bucket: rate-limited` for quick detection in downstream logs.
Sara Patel: telemetry/metrics: emit counter `client_bucket.count` and histogram of `client_bucket.latency_impact` so product can correlate cost vs quality.
Bryan Lee: rollout plan? we should do a small opt-in by org flag, and a non-breaking augment (fields optional) so old clients ignore them. then 4-week canary on dedicated, then host-wide.
Clara Nguyen: timeline proposal: week1 proto + SDK PRs, week2 canary with 10 orgs, week3 add console badges and alerting, week4 full launch.
Alex Kim: SDK note: surface `client_hint` as `error.humanMessage` and keep `error.internalCode` unchanged. add telemetry mapping layer so customers can opt into sending `client_bucket` to their analytics.
Sara Patel: design ask: can we get a one-line copy for each bucket? I'll put in console glossary. Proposed copy: `retryable-backoff` -> "Temporary capacity issue; retry later"; `rate-limited` -> "Request limit reached; consider upgrading"; `degraded` -> "Using lower-quality fallback to preserve availability"
Bryan Lee: reactions: :+1: on copy. ops-bot: created checklist #8472 for runbook updates.
Clara Nguyen: action items: Bryan (update API schema + headers), Sara (runbook + console badge art + copy), Alex (SDK mapping + header surfacing). I'll own telemetry tags and the canary cohort.
Bryan Lee: I'll open PRs today for schema and add feature flag behind `client_bucket_release`.
Sara Patel: adding design tasks to the board and pinging legal on phrasing re: billing messaging.
Alex Kim: I'll add tests for SDKs and backwards compatibility. also propose a small e2e: simulate `SOFT_THROTTLE` and verify message + header.
Clara Nguyen: cool. final ask: keep `internal_code` stable; don't repurpose existing codes. we'll map them to buckets in the routing layer.
Bryan Lee: noted. any objections?
Sara Patel: none. :+1:
Alex Kim: none.
Clara Nguyen: great — thanks team. will post a short RFC doc after this thread.
